text:
Alex P: Quick sync — kicking off Q3 Hosted API roadmap thread. Need concrete launch acceptance criteria for chat, embeddings, and rerank. Focus: measurable SLOs, perf gates, and canary plan. Who's in? :wave:
Marta S: I'm in. I want OKRs that map to customer outcomes not just internal metrics. Recommend 3 launch gates: reliability, cost/unit, quality/regressions.
Sam (eng): Agreed. For reliability we need: 99.9% success rate for 95th perc. inference latency under target, and fallback paths tested. Can quantify.
Riyad (ml): For quality gate on rerank: baseline MAP@10 improvement >= 5% over current model on customer eval sets. Need explicit eval harness and dataset owners.
Tanya (solutions): Enterprise beta customers asked for embedding SLOs — they want 99.95% availability and deterministic hashing for recall. That's a hard ask for hosted.
Alex P: Noted. Let's be pragmatic: separate GA vs enterprise acceptance. GA can have 99.9% for embeddings, enterprise/private gets 99.95% + dedicated pools.
Marta S: For cost gate: target cost/token (chat) within 30% of current baseline, and embedding cost per vector under $0.0008 for common sizes. Otherwise we don't surface as default.
Sam (eng): Technical tradeoffs: to hit cost we need batching + dynamic quantization + optional smaller model family. But batching increases tail latency sometimes. Need to define latency SLOs per segment.
Alex P: Good — define latency SLOs by route: chat interactive (p50 < 250ms, p95 < 800ms), completions longform (p50 < 500ms), embeddings (p50 < 50ms). Are those realistic?
Sam (eng): chat p95 800ms is aggressive but doable for small contexts. We'll need KV cache warm start and prefix caching. Also plan reserve capacity for enterprise canary.
Riyad (ml): Also add quality regression checks: set up continuous eval with prompt set and a holdout of customer prompts. If decoding changes produce >2% drop in QA accuracy or >5% drop in rerank MAP then block.
Tanya (solutions): Customer adoption gate: at least 3 paying customers in beta for GA sign-off, with documented success criteria (latency, accuracy, cost) per customer.
Marta S: Rollout policy: internal canary (10% traffic) -> invited beta (selected customers) -> GA (open). Each step needs rollback plan and smoke tests.
Alex P: Let's list acceptance checklist items. I'll start a canonical doc but posting draft here for visibility:
```
LAUNCH ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST (draft)
- Reliability: endpoint success >= 99.9% over 7 days at expected load
- Latency: route-specific p50/p95 thresholds met under target QPS
- Cost: measured cost/unit within target ranges for 7 days
- Quality: automated evals pass (no regressions beyond thresholds)
- Observability: dashboards for token breakdown, tracing, error types
- Rollout: canary strategy + auto-fallback documented and tested
- Security & compliance: KMS keys verified, audit logs enabled
- Customer beta: >=3 paying customers with acceptance notes
```
Sam (eng): add: load tests including spike scenarios and degraded GPU perf simulated. Also plan for graceful fallback to smaller model variant on overload.
Riyad (ml): add model card/known-failure modes and example prompt regressions in docs. That helps support triage.
Tanya (solutions): I'll volunteer to run the customer acceptance plan and gather the beta signoffs. Will need a single doc template for signoff.
Marta S: OKR mapping proposal: OKR1: Launch Hosted API GA for chat+embeddings with SLOs met. Key results: (a) GA latency SLOs met, (b) cost per token within 30% baseline, (c) 3 beta customers onboarded. OKR2: Rerank quality shipped with eval harness and MAP uplift >=5%.
Alex P: Great. Who will own the canary runbook and rollback automation? Sam?
Sam (eng): I can own canary + rollback automation. Need a small infra ticket for rollout hooks and two runbooks.
Alex P: Assigning tickets: Sam — rollout infra + load tests; Riyad — eval harness + regression thresholds; Tanya — customer signoffs; Marta — OKR tracking + launch comms. I'll create JIRA cards after this thread.
Marta S: Timeline idea: 6-week cadence to GA: 2 weeks infra/metrics + 2 weeks beta + 2 weeks stabilize/fixes. Flexible depending on blockers.
Sam (eng): Sounds tight but workable if we lock model variant choices early. 
Riyad (ml): We'll prioritize the rerank eval datasets and surface a simple API for customer evaluation. 
deploy-bot: Reminder: Planning meeting scheduled 2024-04-11 10:00 PDT — calendar invite sent.
Alex P: Perfect. End goals: measurable acceptance gates, clear owner for each gate, and customer signoff plan. I'll spin up the canonical doc and ping folks with action items. :rocket:
Tanya (solutions): One more ask — include a quick rollback checklist snippet for customers (how to opt into dedicated pool or fall back to older model) so they can be confident.
Alex P: Good call. I'll add that to the doc. Thanks all — wrapping up. :white_check_mark:
Marta S: leaving a +1 reaction. :thumbsup:
